section.content: 本公开涉及机器学习装置。机器学习车辆(2)特有的学习模型的机器学习装置具备：使用包含由设置于车辆的检测器检测出的状态参数的值的训练数据集进行学习模型的机器学习的学习部(146、333)；以及在由检测器检测出的状态参数的值发生了异常的情况下取得由其他车辆检测出的状态参数的值的参数值取得部(145、332)。学习部在由检测器检测出的状态参数的值发生了异常的情况下，使用代替由检测器检测出的状态参数的值而包含由参数值取得部从其他车辆取得的值的训练数据集，进行学习模型的机器学习。由此，即使构成训练数据集的状态参数的值发生了异常，也能适当地学习学习模型。

The present disclosure relates to machine learning devices. A machine learning device for learning a model specific to a vehicle (2) is provided with learning units (146, 333) for learning the model by using a training data set including values of state parameters detected by a detector provided in the vehicle, and parameter value acquisition units (145, 332) for acquiring values of state parameters detected by other vehicles when abnormality occurs in the values of the state parameters detected by the detector. When an abnormality occurs in the value of the state parameter detected by the detector, the learning unit performs machine learning of the learning model using a training data set including the value acquired from the other vehicle by the parameter value acquisition unit instead of the value of the state parameter detected by the detector. Thus, even if abnormality occurs in the values of the state parameters constituting the training data set, the learning model can be appropriately learned.

Machine learning deviceTechnical Field

The present disclosure relates to a machine learning apparatus for machine learning a learning model specific to a vehicle.

Background

It is known to acquire a value of a state parameter associated with a vehicle and perform machine learning of a learning model using the acquired value of the state parameter as a training data set (for example, patent literature 1). In particular, patent document 1 proposes machine learning of a learning model for outputting the temperature of an exhaust gas purification catalyst based on a training data set including values of the engine speed, the engine load factor, the temperature of the exhaust gas purification catalyst, and the like.

Prior art literature

Patent document 1 Japanese patent application laid-open No. 2019-183698

Disclosure of Invention

Problems to be solved by the invention

For example, in the case where a sensor detects a value of a state parameter constituting a training data set, if the sensor is abnormal, the value of the state parameter cannot be accurately detected. When abnormality occurs in the values of the state parameters constituting the training data set in this way, if the learning model is machine-learned using such training data set, the learning model cannot be appropriately learned.

In view of the above-described problems, an object of the present disclosure is to provide a machine learning device capable of appropriately machine-learning a learning model even in the event of an abnormality in the values of state parameters constituting a training data set for the machine-learning model.

Technical scheme for solving problems

The gist of the present disclosure is as follows.

(1) A machine learning device for machine learning a learning model specific to a vehicle includes a learning unit that performs learning of the learning model using a training data set including a value of a state parameter detected by a detector provided in the vehicle, and a parameter value acquisition unit that acquires a value of the state parameter detected by another vehicle under a condition that matches a detection condition when the value of the state parameter included in the training data set is detected by the detector when an abnormality occurs in the value of the state parameter detected by the detector, wherein the learning unit performs learning of the learning model using a training data set including a value acquired from another vehicle in place of the value of the state parameter detected by the detector when an abnormality occurs in the value of the state parameter detected by the detector.

(2) The machine learning device according to the above (1), wherein the parameter value obtaining unit is provided in the vehicle, and obtains the value of the state parameter detected by the other vehicle by inter-vehicle communication with the other vehicle or by communication with a server capable of communicating with the other vehicle.

(3) The machine learning device according to the above (1), which is provided in a server capable of communicating with the vehicle and the other vehicle, and further includes a model transmission unit that transmits information of a learning model learned by the learning unit to the vehicle, wherein the parameter value acquisition unit acquires a value of the state parameter detected by the other vehicle from the other vehicle through communication between the other vehicle and the server, and the learning unit learns the learning model using a training data set including the value of the state parameter acquired from the other vehicle and a value of another state parameter related to the vehicle other than the state parameter transmitted from the vehicle through communication between the vehicle and the server.

(4) The machine learning device according to any one of (1) to (3) above, wherein the state parameter is a physical quantity that has a smaller difference between vehicles under the same detection condition than other state parameters associated with the vehicle.

(5) The machine learning device according to any one of the above (1) to (4), wherein the state parameter is a state parameter associated with an external environment of the vehicle.

(6) The machine learning device according to the above (5), wherein the state parameter includes at least one of a temperature, a humidity, and an atmospheric pressure of an atmosphere surrounding the vehicle.

(7) The machine learning device according to any one of the above (1) to (6), wherein the detection condition includes a time and a place at which a value of the state parameter constituting the training data set of the vehicle is detected by the detector.

Effects of the invention

According to the present disclosure, there is provided a machine learning apparatus capable of appropriately machine learning a learning model even in the event of abnormality in the values of state parameters constituting a training data set for the machine learning model.

Detailed Description

Hereinafter, embodiments will be described in detail with reference to the accompanying drawings. In the following description, the same reference numerals are given to the same constituent elements.

< First embodiment >

Construction of machine learning System

First, a machine learning system 1 according to a first embodiment will be described with reference to fig. 1 to 7. Fig. 1 is a schematic configuration diagram of a machine learning system 1 according to a first embodiment. The machine learning system 1 machine learns a learning model unique to each vehicle using state parameters indicating the state of each vehicle.

As shown in fig. 1, the machine learning system 1 includes a plurality of vehicles 2 and a server 3 that can communicate with each other. Each of the plurality of vehicles 2 and the server 3 are configured to be able to communicate with each other via a communication network 4 and a wireless base station 5, the communication network 4 being configured by an optical communication line or the like, the wireless base station 5 being connected to the communication network 4 via a gateway (not shown). The communication between the vehicle 2 and the wireless base station 5 is a communication conforming to an arbitrary communication standard. In the following description, one of the vehicles 2 using the learning model machine-learned by the machine learning system 1 is referred to as the own vehicle 2a, and vehicles other than the own vehicle 2a are referred to as other vehicles 2b.

Fig. 2 is a diagram schematically showing a hardware configuration of the vehicle 2. As shown in fig. 2, the vehicle 2 includes an Electronic Control Unit (ECU) 11. The ECU11 has an in-vehicle communication interface 12, a memory 13, and a processor 14. The in-vehicle communication interface 12 and the memory 13 are connected to the processor 14 via signal lines. In the present embodiment, the vehicle 2 is provided with one ECU11, but a plurality of ECUs may be provided that are functionally divided.

The in-vehicle communication interface 12 has an interface circuit for connecting the ECU11 to an in-vehicle network 15 conforming to the CAN (Controller Area Network ) or the like standard. The ECU11 communicates with other in-vehicle devices via an in-vehicle communication interface 12.

The memory 13 is an example of a storage unit for storing data. The memory 13 has, for example, a volatile semiconductor memory (e.g., RAM) and a nonvolatile semiconductor memory (e.g., ROM). The memory 13 stores a computer program for executing various processes in the processor 14, various data used when the various processes are executed by the processor 14, and the like. Thus, the memory 13 stores the learning model.

The processor 14 has one or more CPU (Central Processing Unit) and its peripheral circuitry. The processor 14 may further have an arithmetic circuit such as GPU (Graphics Processing Unit) or a logic arithmetic unit or a numerical arithmetic unit. The processor 14 executes various processes based on a computer program stored in the memory 13. Therefore, when the value of the input parameter of the learning model is input, the processor 14 performs arithmetic processing in accordance with the learning model, and outputs the value of the output parameter.

Fig. 3 is a functional block diagram of the processor 14 of the own vehicle 2 a. As shown in fig. 3, the processor 14 includes a control unit 141 for controlling the control device 22 of the vehicle 2a using a learning model, a data transmission unit 142 for transmitting a training data set for machine learning of the learning model to the server 3, and a model update unit 143 for updating the learning model used in the control unit 141. These functional blocks of the processor 14 are, for example, functional blocks implemented by a computer program operating on the processor 14. Alternatively, the functional blocks included in the processor 14 may be dedicated arithmetic circuits provided in the processor 14. Details of the respective functional blocks of the processor 14 of the own vehicle 2a will be described later.

As shown in fig. 2, the vehicle 2 further includes an off-vehicle communication module 21, a plurality of control devices 22, and a plurality of sensors 23. The outside-vehicle communication module 21, the control device 22, and the sensor 23 are connected to the ECU11 via the inside-vehicle network 15.

The off-vehicle communication module 21 is an example of a communication unit that communicates with an off-vehicle device. The off-vehicle communication module 21 is, for example, a device for communicating with the server 3 and the other vehicles 2 b. The off-board communication module 21 includes, for example, a data communication module (DCM: data communication module). The data communication module communicates with the server 3 via the wireless base station 5 and the communication network 4.

The control device 22 is a device that performs various controls related to the vehicle 2. Specifically, the control device 22 includes, for example, a driving actuator of a throttle valve that adjusts an opening degree of the throttle valve provided on an intake passage of the internal combustion engine, an injector that supplies fuel to a combustion chamber of the internal combustion engine, a driving actuator of an EGR valve that controls an EGR rate of the internal combustion engine, a blower of the air conditioning apparatus, a driving actuator of an air mixer door that controls air flow of the air conditioning apparatus, and the like. These control devices 22 are connected to the ECU11 via the in-vehicle network 15, and operate in accordance with drive signals from the ECU 11.

The sensor 23 is an example of a detector that detects values (state amounts) of various state parameters related to the vehicle 2. The sensor 23 includes, for example, an air amount sensor that detects an intake air amount supplied to the internal combustion engine, an injection pressure sensor that detects a fuel injection pressure from an injector of the internal combustion engine, an exhaust temperature sensor that detects a temperature of exhaust gas (exhaust gas), an input detection sensor that detects an input of a driver on a touch panel or the like, a self-position sensor (e.g., GPS) that detects a self-position of the vehicle 2, and the like. The sensors 23 include, for example, an outside air temperature sensor that detects the temperature of the air around the vehicle 2 (outside air temperature), an outside air humidity sensor that detects the humidity of the air around the vehicle 2 (outside air humidity), an atmospheric pressure sensor that detects the atmospheric pressure around the vehicle 2, an in-vehicle temperature sensor that detects the temperature in the room of the vehicle 2 (indoor temperature), an in-vehicle humidity sensor that detects the humidity in the room of the vehicle 2 (indoor humidity), a solar sensor that detects the amount of solar radiation, and the like. These sensors 23 are connected to the ECU11 via the in-vehicle network 15, and transmit output signals to the ECU 11.

The server 3 is provided outside the vehicle 2, and communicates with the vehicle 2 traveling in a specific area via the communication network 4 and the wireless base station 5. The server 3 receives various information from the vehicle 2 traveling in a specific region.

Fig. 4 is a diagram schematically showing a hardware configuration of the server 3. As shown in fig. 4, the server 3 includes an external communication module 31, a storage device 32, and a processor 33. The server 3 may have an input device such as a keyboard and a mouse, and an output device such as a display.

The external communication module 31 is an example of a communication unit that communicates with a device outside the server 3. The external communication module 31 includes an interface circuit for connecting the server 3 to the communication network 4. The external communication module 31 is configured to be capable of communicating with each of the plurality of vehicles 2 via the communication network 4 and the wireless base station 5.

The storage device 32 is an example of a storage unit that stores data. The storage device 32 includes, for example, a Hard Disk Drive (HDD), a Solid State Disk (SSD), or an optical recording medium. The storage device 32 stores a computer program for executing various processes by the processor 33, and various data used when executing various processes by the processor 33.

The processor 33 has one or more CPUs and peripheral circuits thereof. The processor 33 may further have an arithmetic circuit such as a GPU, a logic arithmetic unit, or a numerical arithmetic unit. The processor 33 executes various processes based on a computer program stored in the storage device 32. In the present embodiment, the processor 33 of the server 3 functions as a machine learning device that performs machine learning on a learning model.

Fig. 5 is a functional block diagram of the processor 33 of the server 3. As shown in fig. 5, the processor 33 includes an abnormal parameter determination unit 331 that determines a state parameter in which an abnormality has occurred among the state parameters constituting the training data set transmitted from the host vehicle 2a, a parameter value acquisition unit 332 that acquires a value of the state parameter in which an abnormality has occurred from another vehicle 2b different from the host vehicle 2a, a learning unit 333 that performs machine learning of a learning model, and a model transmission unit 334 that transmits the machine-learned learning model to the host vehicle 2 a. These functional blocks of the processor 33 are, for example, functional blocks implemented by a computer program that operates on the processor 33. Alternatively, the functional blocks included in the processor 33 may be dedicated arithmetic circuits provided in the processor 33. Details of the respective functional blocks of the processor 33 of the server 3 will be described later.

Study model

In the present embodiment, the control unit 141 of the host vehicle 2a uses a learning model learned by machine learning when controlling the control device 22 mounted on the host vehicle 2 a. In the present embodiment, a Neural Network (NN) model (hereinafter, referred to as "NN model") is used as a learning model. Hereinafter, an outline of the NN model will be described with reference to fig. 6. Fig. 6 shows an example of an NN model having a simple structure.

The circles in fig. 6 represent artificial neurons. Artificial neurons are commonly referred to as nodes or cells (referred to as "nodes" in this specification). In fig. 6, l=1 represents an input layer, l=2 and l=3 represents a hidden layer (or intermediate layer), and l=4 represents an output layer.

In fig. 6, x 1 and x 2 denote each node of the input layer (l=1) and an output value from the node, and y denotes a node of the output layer (l=4) and an output value thereof. Similarly, z 1(L＝2)、z2(L＝2) and z 3(L＝2) denote each node of the hidden layer (l=2) and an output value from the node, and z 1(L＝3) and z 2(L＝3) denote each node of the hidden layer (l=3) and an output value from the node.

At each node of the input layer, the input is output as it is. On the other hand, the output values x 1 and x 2 of the nodes of the input layer are input to the nodes of the hidden layer (l=2), and the total input value u is calculated using the weights w and the offsets b corresponding to the nodes of the hidden layer (l=2). For example, in fig. 6, the total input value u k(L＝2) calculated at each node indicated by z k(L＝2) (k=1, 2, 3) in the hidden layer (l=2) is expressed as follows (M is the number of nodes in the input layer).

Next, the total input value u k(L＝2) is converted by the activation function f, and is output from the node shown by z k(L＝2) of the hidden layer (l=2) as an output value z k(L＝2)(＝f(uk(L＝2)). On the other hand, the output values z 1(L＝2)、z2(L＝2) and z 3(L＝2) of the nodes of the hidden layer (l=2) are input to the nodes of the hidden layer (l=3), and the total input value u (=Σz·w+b) is calculated using the weights w and the offsets b corresponding to the nodes of the hidden layer (l=3). The total input value u is also converted by the activation function, and is output from each node of the hidden layer (l=3) as an output value z 1(L＝3)、z2(L＝3). The activation function is, for example, a ReLU function (linear rectification function) σ.

The output values z 1(L＝3) and z 2(L＝3) of the nodes of the hidden layer (l=3) are input to the nodes of the output layer (l=4), and the total input value u (Σz·w+b) is calculated using the weights w and the offsets b corresponding to the nodes of the output layer, or the total input value u (Σz·w) is calculated using only the weights w corresponding to the nodes. For example, an identity function is used as an activation function at a node of the output layer. In this case, the total input value u calculated at the node of the output layer is outputted as it is as the output value y from the node of the output layer.

Thus, the NN model includes an input layer, a hidden layer, and an output layer, and when one or more input parameters are input from the input layer, one or more output parameters corresponding to the input parameters are output from the output layer.

In the present embodiment, as such a learning model, for example, a model is used that outputs the temperature of the exhaust gas as the value of the output parameter when the values of the external air temperature, the intake air amount, the fuel injection timing, the fuel injection pressure, and the EGR rate are input as the values of the input parameters. The control unit 141 of the vehicle 2a inputs the values of the respective input parameters detected by the sensors 23 into the learning model, and outputs the temperature of the exhaust gas. The control unit 141 controls the control device 22 related to the internal combustion engine based on the output temperature of the exhaust gas. Here, since there is a response delay in the exhaust gas temperature sensor that detects the temperature of the exhaust gas, if the control of the internal combustion engine is performed based on the output of the exhaust gas temperature sensor, the internal combustion engine is not necessarily controlled appropriately. In contrast, since the calculation of the temperature of the exhaust gas using the learning model does not cause a delay, the internal combustion engine can be controlled more appropriately by controlling the internal combustion engine using the temperature of the exhaust gas calculated by the learning model.

Alternatively, as such a learning model, for example, a model may be used in which, when the outside air temperature, the inside humidity, and the amount of sunlight are input as values of input parameters, the target temperature of the air conditioner is output as values of output parameters. In this case, the control unit 141 of the vehicle 2a inputs the values of the respective input parameters detected by the sensors 23 into the learning model, and outputs the target temperature of the air conditioner. The ECU11 controls the control device 22 related to the air conditioner so that the in-vehicle temperature becomes the target temperature output from the learning model.

Further, as the learning model, various models can be used. Accordingly, as the input parameters, various state parameters indicating the state of the vehicle, such as an outside air temperature, an outside air humidity, an atmospheric pressure, an indoor temperature, an indoor humidity, a solar radiation amount, an intake air temperature, a fuel injection pressure, a fuel injection timing, a fuel injection amount, an air-fuel ratio, an ignition timing, an engine cooling water temperature, and a boost pressure, can be used. As the output parameter, various state parameters indicating the state of the vehicle, such as the temperature of the exhaust gas purification catalyst, the concentration of NOx in the exhaust gas, the engine output torque, and the humidity in the vehicle, can be used.

Basic study of study model

Next, machine learning of the learning model (NN model) as described above will be described. In order to improve the accuracy of such an NN model, machine learning of the NN model is required. Then, in the present embodiment, the learning unit 333 of the server 3 performs machine learning of the NN model. First, a method of learning the NN model by the learning unit 333 will be briefly described.

In the machine learning of the NN model, a training data set including values of state parameters detected by the sensors 23 provided in the vehicle 2 is used. The training data set is composed of a combination of a plurality of actual measurement values of a plurality of input parameters and a plurality of actual measurement values (forward solution data) of at least one output parameter corresponding to the actual measurement values. In the present embodiment, the actual measured value of the input parameter and the actual measured value of the output parameter are values detected by the sensor 23 of the host vehicle 2a or control command values from the ECU11 to the control device 22. In the present embodiment, when the server 3 performs machine learning of the NN model, the actual measurement value used as the training data set is transmitted from the host vehicle 2a to the server 3.

The learning unit 333 of the server 3 performs machine learning of the NN model after preprocessing (normalization, etc.) the training data set transmitted from the own vehicle 2a. When performing machine learning of the NN model, the learning unit 333 repeatedly updates the weights w and the offsets b in the NN model by, for example, a known error back propagation method so that the difference between the output value of the NN model and the actual measured value of the output parameter included in the training data set becomes small. As a result, the NN model is learned, and a learned NN model is generated. The information (model structure, weight w, bias b, etc.) of the learned NN model is stored in the storage device 32 of the server, and is transmitted from the server 3 to the host vehicle 2a.

Learning when abnormality occurs in state parameter value

When an abnormality such as a failure occurs in the sensor 23 that detects the value of the state parameter constituting the training data set, for example, an error occurs in the output of the sensor 23, or the sensor 23 does not output a signal. If machine learning of the learning model is performed using the output of the sensor 23 in which the abnormality has occurred in this way, machine learning cannot be performed appropriately on the learning model.

Then, in the present embodiment, when an abnormality occurs in the value of the state parameter detected by the sensor 23, the value of the state parameter is acquired from the other vehicle 2b located in the same area as the host vehicle 2a, and the learning model is machine-learned using the training data set including the value acquired from the other vehicle 2b instead of the value of the state parameter detected by the sensor 23. Hereinafter, machine learning of a learning model in the case where an abnormality occurs in the value of a state parameter detected by the sensor 23 will be described specifically with reference to fig. 7.

Fig. 7 is an operation timing chart of the learning process performed by the machine learning system 1. In particular, fig. 7 is a timing chart of operations when machine learning is performed on a learning model used when the control device 22 of the own vehicle 2a is controlled in the case where an abnormality occurs in the outside air temperature sensor of the own vehicle 2 a.

As shown in fig. 7, the other vehicle 2b periodically detects the value of the state parameter including the outside air temperature and the detection condition at that time, respectively (step S11). The value of the state parameter is detected by the sensor 23 of the other vehicle 2 b. In particular, the outside air temperature in the state parameter is detected by an outside air temperature sensor. The detection condition indicates a condition when the value of each state parameter is detected by the sensor 23, and in the present embodiment, includes a time and a place when the value of each state parameter is detected. The time at which the value of each state parameter is detected is acquired from the ECU11 of the other vehicle 2b functioning as a clock. The position at which the value of each state parameter is detected by the own position sensor. The detection conditions may include, for example, the precipitation amount detected by the rain sensor, and various other conditions such as the style of the vehicle.

The processor 14 of the other vehicle 2b causes the memory 13 to store the values of the detected state parameters and the detection conditions under which the state parameters are detected. The data transmission unit 142 of the processor 14 of the other vehicle 2b transmits the detection conditions and the types of the detected state parameters stored in the memory 13 to the server 3 via the off-vehicle communication module 21 at regular intervals. The server 3 stores the received detection conditions and the type of the status parameter in the storage device 32.

On the other hand, the own vehicle 2a periodically detects the value of the state parameter for the machine learning model and the detection condition at that time (step S12). The value of the state parameter is detected by the sensor 23 of the own vehicle 2a, and the detection condition is obtained from the ECU11 or is detected by the sensor 23. In the example shown in fig. 7, since an abnormality occurs in the outside air temperature sensor of the host vehicle 2a, a large error occurs in the outside air temperature detected by the outside air temperature sensor.

The processor 14 of the vehicle 2a causes the memory 13 to store the time-series values of the detected plurality of state parameters and the detection conditions for each value of the detected state parameters. When detecting the values of the state parameters of the number required for machine learning and storing the values in the memory 13, the data transmission unit 142 of the vehicle 2a sums the time-series values of the plurality of state parameters stored in the memory 13 and transmits the values as a training data set to the server 3, and transmits the detection conditions of the respective values of the state parameters to the server 3. The server 3 stores the received training data set and the detection conditions in the storage device 32. The data transmission unit 142 of the host vehicle 2a may transmit the value of the state parameter and the detection condition to the server 3 each time they are detected.

When the values of the state parameters of the number required for machine learning are stored in the storage device 32 as the training data set, the abnormal parameter determination unit 331 of the server 3 determines whether or not the state parameters of the abnormality have occurred in the training data set, and determines the state parameters when the abnormal state parameters have occurred (step S13). The abnormality parameter determination unit 331 determines that an abnormality has occurred in the value of the state parameter when the value of the state parameter is such an abnormality as is unlikely to occur (for example, when the value of the state parameter is detected to be greater than 50 ℃ in winter), when the value of the state parameter is fixed to a certain value (for example, when the value of the state parameter is detected to be fixed to 25 ℃ in the course of the day), or when no signal is output from the sensor and the value of the state parameter is defective. When the abnormality parameter determination unit 331 determines that there is no abnormal state parameter, the server 3 performs machine learning of the learning model in step S16 described later.

In the present embodiment, the abnormality parameter determination unit 331 of the server 3 determines a parameter in which an abnormality has occurred. However, other methods may be used to determine the parameters in which the anomaly occurred. For example, when the processor 14 of the host vehicle 2a can perform the fault diagnosis of the sensor 23 mounted on the host vehicle 2a, the state parameter detected by the sensor 23 diagnosed as faulty may be determined as the abnormal state parameter. In this case, the processor 14 of the host vehicle 2a functions as the abnormality parameter determination unit 331, and the data transmission unit 142 transmits the type of the parameter in which the abnormality has occurred to the server 3 in addition to the value of the state parameter and the detection condition.

When the abnormality parameter determination unit 331 determines a state parameter in which an abnormality has occurred (hereinafter referred to as an "abnormality occurrence state parameter". In the example shown in fig. 7, the outside air temperature), the parameter value acquisition unit 332 of the server 3 acquires the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter from the other vehicle 2 b. In particular, in the present embodiment, the parameter value acquisition unit 332 acquires, from the other vehicle 2b, the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the other vehicle 2b under the condition that matches the detection condition when the value of the state parameter constituting the training data set is detected in the own vehicle 2a.

Therefore, when it is determined that an abnormality has occurred in the state parameter detected by the sensor 23, the parameter value acquisition unit 332 of the server 3 determines the other vehicle 2b that is to acquire the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter (step S14). The parameter value acquisition unit 332 searches for the other vehicle 2b that transmitted the detection condition that matches the detection condition when the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter is detected in the own vehicle 2a, from among the many other vehicles 2b that transmitted the detection condition. Specifically, for example, the other vehicle 2b that detected the state parameter at the time and place that most coincides with the time and place at which the value of the state parameter included in the training data set was detected in the own vehicle 2a is determined as the other vehicle 2b that is to acquire the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter.

When the other vehicle 2b that has acquired the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter is determined, the parameter value acquisition unit 332 requests the other vehicle 2b to transmit the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter (i.e., the outside air temperature). In particular, the parameter value acquisition unit 332 transmits a signal requesting the specified other vehicle 2b to transmit the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the specified other vehicle 2b under the detection condition conforming to the detection condition of the training data set to the other vehicle 2b via the external communication module 31.

When the processor 14 of the other vehicle 2b is requested to transmit the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter, the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected under the detection condition that matches the detection condition of the training data set is acquired from the memory 13 (step S15). The processor 14 of the other vehicle 2b transmits the acquired value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter to the server 3 via the off-vehicle communication module 21. The parameter value obtaining unit 332 of the server 3 obtains the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the other vehicle 2b through communication with the other vehicle 2b and the server 3 in this manner. Therefore, when an abnormality occurs in the value of a certain state parameter (abnormality occurrence state parameter) detected by the sensor 23, the parameter value acquisition unit 332 of the server 3 acquires the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the other vehicle 2b under a condition that matches the detection condition when the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter included in the training data set of the own vehicle 2a is detected by the sensor 23.

The learning unit 333 of the server 3 performs machine learning of the learning model using the training data set created by the own vehicle 2a and/or the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter transmitted from the other vehicle 2b (step S16). When it is determined that the abnormal state parameter is not present in the abnormal state parameter determination unit 331, the learning unit 333 performs machine learning of the learning model by using the learning method described above, using only the training data set transmitted from the host vehicle 2 a. On the other hand, when the abnormality occurrence state parameter is determined by the abnormality parameter determination unit 331, the learning unit 333 performs machine learning of the learning model by the above-described learning method using a training data set including the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter acquired from the other vehicle 2b by the parameter value acquisition unit 332, instead of the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the sensor 23 of the own vehicle 2 a. That is, in this case, the learning unit 333 performs machine learning of the learning model using the training data set including the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter acquired from the other vehicle 2b by the parameter value acquisition unit 332 and the value of the other state parameter than the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the sensor 23 of the own vehicle 2a and transmitted from the own vehicle 2 a. Specifically, in the present embodiment, the training data set includes data of the atmospheric temperature acquired by the parameter value acquisition unit 332 from the other vehicle 2b instead of data of the atmospheric temperature detected by the atmospheric temperature sensor of the own vehicle 2a, and data of other state parameters (for example, intake air amount, fuel injection pressure) detected by other sensors (for example, an air amount sensor, an injection pressure sensor) of the own vehicle 2a and/or data of other state parameters (for example, fuel injection amount, fuel injection timing) as control command values from the ECU11 to the control device 22.

When the machine learning of the learning model is completed, the learning unit 333 causes the storage device 32 of the server 3 to store the information of the learned learning model. When the machine learning of the learning model is completed, the model transmitting unit 334 of the server 3 transmits the information (for example, the updated weight w and/or the offset b) of the learned learning model to the own vehicle 2a.

Upon receiving the information of the learned learning model, the model updating unit 143 of the vehicle 2a updates the information of the learning model stored in the memory 13 of the vehicle 2a (step S17). Thus, when the control unit 141 subsequently performs control of the control device 22 using the learning model, the control unit performs control of the control device 22 based on the updated learning model.

Effect and modification

According to the above embodiment, for example, when an abnormality occurs in the value of the state parameter constituting the training data set due to occurrence of an abnormality such as a failure in the sensor 23 of the own vehicle 2a, the training data set including the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the other vehicle 2b is used instead of the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter in which the abnormality has occurred, and the machine learning of the learning model is performed. As a result, according to the above embodiment, even if there is an abnormality in the value of the state parameter detected by the sensor 23 of the own vehicle 2a, the machine learning of the learning model can be performed using the training data set in which the value of the state parameter is relatively accurate. Therefore, even in the case where an abnormality occurs in the values of the state parameters constituting the training data set for the machine learning model, the machine learning model can be appropriately performed.

In the present embodiment, the server 3 performs machine learning of the learning model. Therefore, since it is not necessary to perform the learning process with a high calculation load in the host vehicle 2a, it is not necessary to make the processing capacity of the processor 14 of the host vehicle 2a too high, and thus the manufacturing cost of the host vehicle 2a can be reduced.

In the above-described embodiment, the example of machine learning in which the learning model is performed when the outside air temperature sensor fails and the outside air temperature detected by the outside air temperature sensor is abnormal has been described. However, the learning method of the learning model described above can also be applied to a case where the sensor 23 other than the outside air temperature sensor fails and the value of the state parameter other than the outside air temperature is abnormal.

In particular, the learning method of the learning model described above can be applied to a case where abnormality occurs in the value of the state parameter that indicates the same value even if the vehicle 2 is different under the same detection condition. Therefore, the learning method of the learning model described above can be applied to a case where there is an abnormality in a value detected by the sensor 23 of the own vehicle 2a in a state parameter that is related to the own vehicle 2a and that represents a physical quantity that is smaller in difference between the vehicles 2 under the same detection condition than other state parameters. In particular, since the detection value of the external environment around the host vehicle 2a is almost the same between the host vehicle 2a and the other vehicles 2b around the host vehicle 2a, the learning method of the learning model described above can be applied to a case where there is an abnormality in the value of the state parameter associated with the external environment around the host vehicle 2a detected by the sensor 23 of the host vehicle 2 a. Examples of such a state parameter include the humidity and the atmospheric pressure of the atmosphere around the host vehicle 2a, in addition to the atmospheric temperature around the host vehicle 2 a.

In the above embodiment, the other vehicle 2b transmits the type of the state parameter and the detection condition detected in step S11 to the server 3. However, the other vehicle 2b may transmit the value of the state parameter detected in step S11 and the detection condition to the server 3. In this case, the values of the state parameters detected in the other vehicles 2b are stored in the storage device 32 of the server 3. Therefore, when the other vehicle 2b is determined in step S14, the server 3 does not request the other vehicle 2b to transmit the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter, but acquires the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the other vehicle 2b from the storage device 32.

The learning model to be machine-learned in the server 3 may be a machine learning model other than a neural network, such as a random forest, a k-nearest neighbor method, or a support vector machine.

< Second embodiment >

Next, a machine learning system 1 according to a second embodiment will be described with reference to fig. 8 to 10. The following mainly describes differences from the machine learning system according to the first embodiment.

In the present embodiment, the processor 14 of the host vehicle 2a functions as a machine learning device that performs machine learning on a learning model. Fig. 8 is a functional block diagram of the processor 14 of the host vehicle 2a according to the second embodiment. As shown in fig. 8, the processor 14 includes a control unit 141 for controlling the control device 22 of the host vehicle 2a using a learning model, an abnormal parameter determination unit 144 for determining a state parameter in which an abnormality has occurred among the state parameters constituting the training data set created by the host vehicle 2a, a parameter value acquisition unit 145 for acquiring a value of the state parameter in which an abnormality has occurred from another vehicle 2b different from the host vehicle 2a, a learning unit 146 for learning the learning model, and a model update unit 143 for updating the learning model used in the control unit 141.

Fig. 9 is a functional block diagram of the processor 33 of the server 3 according to the second embodiment. As shown in fig. 9, the processor 33 includes a vehicle specifying unit 335 that specifies another vehicle 2b that is to acquire the value of the abnormality occurrence parameter, and a parameter value transmitting unit 336 that transmits the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter acquired from the other vehicle 2b to the host vehicle 2a.

Fig. 10 is an operation timing chart of learning processing performed by the machine learning system 1 according to the second embodiment. In particular, fig. 10 is a timing chart of operations when machine learning is performed on a learning model of the control device 22 for controlling the own vehicle 2a in the case where an abnormality occurs in the outside air temperature sensor of the own vehicle 2 a.

As shown in fig. 10, as in step S11 of fig. 7, the other vehicle 2b periodically detects a value of a state parameter including the outside air temperature and a detection condition at that time, and stores the detected value in the memory 13 (step S21). The data transmission unit 142 of the processor 14 of the other vehicle 2b transmits the detection conditions and the types of the detected state parameters stored in the memory 13 to the server 3 via the off-vehicle communication module 21 at regular intervals.

On the other hand, as in step S12 of fig. 7, the own vehicle 2a periodically detects the value of the state parameter for machine learning the learning model and the detection condition at that time, and stores the detected value in the memory 13 (step S22). When detecting the values of the state parameters of the number required for learning and storing the values in the memory 13, the processor 14 of the vehicle 2a creates a training data set by integrating the time-series values of the plurality of state parameters stored in the memory 13.

When creating the training data set, the abnormality parameter determination unit 144 of the processor 14 of the own vehicle 2a determines whether or not an abnormal state parameter (abnormality occurrence state parameter) has occurred in the training data set, as in step S13 of fig. 7, and determines the abnormal state parameter (outside air temperature in this example) when the abnormal state parameter has occurred (step S23).

When the abnormality parameter determination unit 144 determines the abnormality occurrence state parameter, the parameter value acquisition unit 145 of the own vehicle 2a acquires the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter from the other vehicle 2 b. In particular, in the present embodiment, the parameter value acquisition unit 145 acquires, from the other vehicle 2b, the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the other vehicle 2b under the condition that matches the detection condition when the value of the state parameter constituting the training data set is detected in the own vehicle 2 a.

Therefore, first, when it is determined that an abnormality has occurred in the state parameter detected by the sensor 23, the parameter value obtaining unit 145 transmits the type of the state parameter having the abnormality and the detection condition to the server 3.

When the type of the abnormality occurrence state parameter and the detection condition are transmitted from the host vehicle 2a, the vehicle specifying unit 335 of the server 3 specifies another vehicle 2b that is to acquire the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter in the same manner as in step S14 of fig. 7 (step S24). The vehicle determination unit 335 searches for the other vehicles 2b that have transmitted the detection condition that matches the detection condition when the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter is detected in the own vehicle 2a, from among the many other vehicles 2b that have transmitted the detection condition. When the vehicle determination unit 335 determines another vehicle 2b that has acquired the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter, it requests the other vehicle 2b to transmit the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter (i.e., the outside air temperature).

When the processor 14 of the other vehicle 2b is requested to transmit the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter, the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected under the detection condition that matches the detection condition of the training data set is acquired from the memory 13 in the same manner as in step S15 of fig. 7 (step S25). The processor 14 of the other vehicle 2b transmits the acquired value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter to the server 3. Upon receiving the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter from the other vehicle 2b, the parameter value transmitting unit 336 of the server 3 transmits the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter to the host vehicle 2a. The parameter value obtaining unit 145 of the own vehicle 2a obtains the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the other vehicle 2b through communication between the own vehicle 2a and the server 3 capable of communicating with the other vehicle 2b in this manner. Therefore, when an abnormality occurs in the value of a certain state parameter (abnormality occurrence state parameter) detected by the sensor 23, the parameter value acquisition unit 145 of the own vehicle 2a acquires the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the other vehicle 2b under a condition that matches the detection condition when the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter included in the training data set of the own vehicle 2a is detected by the sensor 23.

As in step S16 of fig. 7, the learning unit 146 of the own vehicle 2a performs machine learning of the learning model using the training data set created by the own vehicle 2a and/or the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter transmitted from the other vehicle 2b (step S26). When the abnormality parameter determination unit 144 determines that the abnormality occurrence state parameter does not exist, the learning unit 146 performs machine learning of the learning model by using the learning method described above, using only the training data set created by the host vehicle 2 a. On the other hand, when the abnormality occurrence state parameter is determined by the abnormality parameter determination unit 144, the learning unit 146 performs machine learning of the learning model by the above-described learning method using a training data set including the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter acquired from the other vehicle 2b by the parameter value acquisition unit 145 instead of the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the sensor 23 of the own vehicle 2 a. That is, in this case, the learning unit 146 performs machine learning of the learning model using the training data set including the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter acquired from the other vehicle 2b by the parameter value acquisition unit 145 and the value of the other state parameter other than the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the sensor 23 of the own vehicle 2 a.

When the machine learning of the learning model is completed, the model updating unit 143 of the vehicle 2a updates the information (for example, the weight w and/or the bias b) of the learning model stored in the memory 13 of the vehicle 2a (step S27). Thus, when the control unit 141 subsequently performs control of the control device 22 using the learning model, the control unit performs control of the control device 22 based on the updated learning model.

Effect and modification

In the present embodiment, the own vehicle 2a performs machine learning of the learning model. If all the machine learning of the learning model of the vehicle 2 is performed by the server 3, the calculation load on the server 3 becomes extremely high, but in the present embodiment, the machine learning of the learning model is performed by the own vehicle 2a, so the calculation load on the server 3 can be reduced.

In the above embodiment, the parameter value obtaining unit 145 of the host vehicle 2a obtains the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the other vehicle 2b through communication between the server 3 capable of communicating with the other vehicle 2b and the host vehicle 2a. However, the parameter value obtaining unit 145 of the own vehicle 2a may obtain the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the other vehicle 2b through inter-vehicle communication between the own vehicle 2a and the other vehicle 2 b. In this case, when the processor 14 of the other vehicle 2b acquires the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter from the memory 13 in step S25, the processor directly transmits the acquired value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter to the host vehicle 2a via inter-vehicle communication.
